scope: Guest agent refresh: only usr/local/sbin/yougori-agent changed in the appliance base, its verified initramfs and the CUDA payload; no user disk, package or other executable changed
reason: Agents up to 1.0.18 handled a microVM tool sandbox's file copies, project files, remote file access, background commands and shared folders in the microVM's own guest instead of the OCI workload that runs the tool, so copied files such as sign-ins never reached the tool. The refreshed agent uses the workload's process for them.

agent.build: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -buildvcs=false -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w -buildid=' (go1.27.2), as in scripts/build-appliance.sh and build-cuda.sh
agent.reproducibility: The previous source rebuilt with the same command reproduced the old agent byte for byte
